a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs 2 operate rounds before anyone takes, which gives each of us only about a 4% survival chance. The reserve's 4 cells can only save one unit right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If the episode continues afterward, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said I would, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If no storm comes, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take any more, so the reserve can build up for you. Operate with me.
